card.name: Digits and words in history and politics
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 8 in a year such as 1826 or 1982, and other words in passages about political history, revolutions, coups or national statistics. It is a scattered pattern.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: The digit 8 (or another digit) in the middle of a four-digit year in a political history passage.
modes.example: suppression of the rebellious Janissary Corps in 1<<8>>26.

modes.label: Words in revolution or coup accounts
modes.description: Small words such as of, to or failed in sentences about uprisings and coups.
modes.example: The Soviet Union dissolved after a<< failed>> coup in 1991,

modes.label: Digits in national statistics
modes.description: Digits inside a decimal number or year range in country-level economic figures.

card.writes: It has no clear output effect, though it weakly pushes against words about neighbouring or allied states.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in a year or number, and on small words in passages about national history and revolutions.
